caption: The drawing shows a chair depicted from three angles: top view, front view, and side view, rendered in black ink on a beige background. The top view reveals a trapezoidal seat with the front edge longer than the back, and small square sections representing the legs at each corner, accompanied by dimensions such as 14½", 15¼", and 18½". The front view displays a ladder-back chair with four horizontally curved back slats and slightly flared back legs, measured at 37" in overall height and 18" width at the top. The side view highlights the profile of the seat, legs, and the back posts which curve outward, including various labeled dimensions for the seat height (16½"), back slat positions, and the stance of the legs. Numerical dimensions are indicated in inches throughout the drawing, and all lines are uniformly shaded in black, with no visible shading or color fill in the illustration. The sheet has a plain, aged paper texture with some scattered small brown spots.
title: Side Chair
